description: Reverse-split episodes across companies that ended without the split taking effect, from Signal8's SEC-filing tracker: outcome "vote_failed" (shareholders did not approve), "abandoned" (the company said it will not proceed), "authority_expired" (an approval lapsed unused past its stated deadline) or "postponed_indefinitely". Splits that did happen are not in this list, and it is cross-company rather than one company's full history. Newest end first. Each row is the Reverse Splits page row (ticker, companyName, hasPage, ratio / ratioMin / ratioMax, trackerState, meetingDate, approvedDate, exchange, securityType, marketCapUsd, cik, approvalPath, domicile, splitAuthority, authorityTerms, verification) plus sourceUrl / sourceAccession and sourceDocuments (every document behind the episode, each with accession or URL) and an "ended" block: outcome, outcomeLabel, endedOn, endedOnBasis, closedReason (the tracker's own note, verbatim), voteDate, closingAccession / closingUrl (the filing that closed it, when one did). endedOnBasis says what endedOn is: "vote_date" or "meeting_date" = the vote as stated; "authority_expiry" = the stated last day of the authority; "closing_filing" = the ET day of the filing that closed it; "recorded" = none of those, the day the tracker recorded the close, which can be later than the event. Null means not measured or not stated. An empty list is what the tracker has on file for the window, not evidence that no company abandoned a split; completeness "tracked_episodes" = what the tracker has read from filings since it started, not every company. boundReached: true = the window held more episodes than one read returns (a narrower from / to window returns the rest). Locked rows are withheld, not absent. The facts are part of Signal8 Pro: a key not owned by a Pro account gets rows with locked: true and only ticker, companyName, hasPage and exchange (access "preview", lockedCount); a locked row means the facts were withheld from this caller. outcome, from and to are Pro-only filters: on a non-Pro key they apply to unlocked rows only and locked rows are left out (filtersLimitedToUnlocked: true). exchange applies to every row. Paging uses limit and the nextCursor of the previous response (null = last page). available: false (reason "tracker_not_enabled") = the tracker is switched off; an HTTP 503 FEATURE_DISABLED = the Reverse Splits page is switched off. In both cases the response says nothing about any company. The data describes what is on file and carries no view on the company, its price, or what anyone should do.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

exchange.description: Listing venues to keep: NASDAQ, NYSE, AMEX (NYSE American), OTC, or not_measured. Empty = every row.

outcome.description: Outcomes to keep: vote_failed, abandoned, authority_expired, postponed_indefinitely. Empty = all four.

to.description: Latest endedOn, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, US Eastern).

name: get_ended_reverse_splits
title: Get Ended Reverse Splits
